messages:
Anya (Partnerships): Quick sync from the SummitAI call — they want to onboard an open 2.7B model and offer it two ways: (1) hosted runtime via their marketplace, (2) downloadable weight bundle for SI customers. They pushed on license + redistribution + joint announce. Thoughts?
Mike (Legal): Need to confirm the model license. If it's permissive (Apache/ML), hosted SaaS is fine. If it's CC-* with NC or SA terms, downloadable redistribution may be restricted. Also require export control attestation from provider.
Jordan (Marketplace): Hosted SKU is ideal for us (lower support burden). Marketplace economics: standard 15% hosting fee, 5% for downloadable SKUs. Downloadable requires a signed distribution addendum and a DPA. We also need a provenance entry and checksum.
Lucy (Solutions): For SI installs we need: model signature file, quantization profile (if shipping q4/q8 artifacts), and a reference container image. Also need a short integration guide (< 2 pages) so partners can plug into our Dedicated offering.
Sam (Eng Runtime): Eng note: we need the weights in either HF-Transformers or ONNX format. We will validate 4-bit quantized artifacts on our testbed. Can we get a sample 1M-token prompt set to validate quality regressions?
Anya (Partnerships): SummitAI suggested the downloadable bundle be permitted for resellers under a redistribution clause. They asked whether we can host the weights on S3 or require them to self-host.
Mike (Legal): We should avoid uncapped redistribution. Proposed minimal clause: `Redistribution Allowed: Recipient may distribute model artifacts to end customers only under the terms of the original license and a signed Distribution Addendum with Redwood. Redistribution to third-party marketplaces requires explicit consent.` Please review.
Jordan (Marketplace): S3 hosting by us is possible but requires explicit EULA + checksum publish. If provider self-hosts, we need signed URL assurances and integrity metadata: `sha256:3f7a...b2c9`.
Lucy (Solutions): Also request telemetry opt-in for SI deployments — usage pings (anonymized) to help with perf tuning. Partner must sign off on telemetry fields.
Anya (Partnerships): On announcements — partner wants co-blog + joint webinar, embargo Jan 25. We need logos, partner quotes, and an interlock with marketing + legal. Who can lead press QA?
Mike (Legal): I'll draft the distribution addendum and a short export-control attestation template. Also confirm commercial-use permission in writing before any public announcement.
Sam (Eng Runtime): Small ops ask: provide a tiny reproducible container or Dockerfile we can run in staging. Add `RUN pip install redwood-runtime==2.1.0` example.
announce-bot: Reminder: create marketplace SKU stub — /sku create summitai-2.7b-hosted (assigned to Jordan).
Anya (Partnerships): Action items: 1) Mike — draft addendum + attestation (ETA 48h). 2) Jordan — create SKU stub and pricing proposal. 3) Sam/Lucy — integration checklist + test container request. 4) Anya — coordinate press assets and embargo calendar. Tagging: @Mike (Legal) @Jordan (Marketplace) @Lucy (Solutions) :thumbsup:
